# Huahua's Tech Road

> A comprehensive tech resource covering algorithmic problem-solving, video/display technology standards, and technology analysis with deep technical insights.

Huahua's Tech Road is a technical blog featuring in-depth explorations of LeetCode problems, HDR and video streaming standards, consumer electronics analysis, and software engineering topics. The site combines practical coding interview preparation with cutting-edge technology analysis.

## Key Topics

- LeetCode problems
- Tree algorithms
- Binary tree traversal
- Data structures
- Coding interviews
- HDR standards
- Dolby Vision
- Display technology
- Tone mapping
- Video streaming
- C++ programming
- Algorithm solutions
- Software engineering
- Apple products
- Real-time video generation

## LeetCode & Algorithm Problems

- [LeetCode Problem Categories](https://zxi.mytechroad.com/blog/leetcode-problem-categories): Comprehensive LeetCode problem list organized by categories with focus on tree algorithms and traversal techniques

## Video & Display Technology

- [HDR Dynamic Metadata, PQ, HLG, and Dolby Vision Explained](https://zxi.mytechroad.com/blog/video/hdr-dynamic-metadata-pq-hlg-dolby-vision-explained): Technical deep-dive into HDR standards, tone curves, display capabilities, and Dolby Vision implementation
- [HDR Brightness Standards vs. Reality](https://zxi.mytechroad.com/blog/video/hdr-brightness-standards-vs-reality): Analysis of HDR brightness standards, tone-mapping techniques, and practical display implementations
- [Visual Turing Moment: SeeDance 2.0 and Real-time 4K 60fps Forecast](https://zxi.mytechroad.com/blog/video/visual-turing-moment-seedance-2-realtime-4k-60fps-forecast): Exploration of SeeDance 2.0 capabilities and computational requirements for real-time 4K video generation

## Technology Analysis & Reviews

- [MacBook Neo vs Air: Apple's Product Positioning Strategy](https://zxi.mytechroad.com/blog/technology/macbook-neo-vs-air-a18pro-analysis): Comparative analysis of MacBook Neo and Air positioning and Apple's product tier strategy

## Learning Resources

- [Recommended Books](https://zxi.mytechroad.com/blog/books): Curated book recommendations covering algorithms, data structures, and software engineering fundamentals

## Society & Urban Planning

- [Trapped in Suburbia: Urban Planning and Public Transportation in the Bay Area](https://zxi.mytechroad.com/blog/society/trapped-in-suburbia-no-transit): Analysis of urban planning issues, suburbia development, and public transportation infrastructure challenges
